------
Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA ------
For the Petitioners : Mr. Ashok Kr. Singh, Advocate For the State : Mr. Praful Jojo, Addl.P.P ------
Order No.03 Dated- 19.05.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending their arrest in connection with Barhi (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 02 of 2022 instituted under Sections 376/406/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act,
the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
Petitioner no. 1 is the father of the main accused and the petitioner no. 2 is the maternal uncle and the petitioner no. 3 is the friend of petitioner no. 2.

As per complaint petition lodged by the victim who is aged about 17 years is that she was under love affairs with the son of the petitioner no. 1 i.e. Alok Soni and both were willing to solemnize marriage with each other and had established physical relationship and in the meanwhile the mother,
maternal uncle and maternal grandmother of the complainant has settled her marriage with one Anup Soni.

It is alleged that the present petitioners assured her marriage with victim Alok Soni and also Rs. 3,00,000/- and 10 grams golden chain and 3 gram golden ring was taken from the complainant by persuading her and later on they refused from solemnization of marriage of the victim with Alok Soni.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and no specific role about commission of any offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act have been constituted against the petitioners.

Petitioners have received no amount of money at any point of time and no evidence has been adduced along with in the case to establish the received of Rs. 3,00,000/- by the petitioners constituting the offence under Sections 420, 406 IPC.

It is further submitted that petitioners undertake to co-operate with the investigation of the case and will not indulge in tampering with prosecution evidence and will abide by all terms and conditions imposed by this Court in the matter of granting anticipatory bail.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioners may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioners coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrendering, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty five thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.D.J. - III-cum-Spl. Judge, POCSO Act in connection with Barhi (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 02 of 2022 with the condition that they will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish their mobile numbers and photocopy of the Aadhar Cards with an undertaking that they will not change their mobile numbers during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Umesh/-
